feature_policy: filter genes detected in at least 3 spots, remove ERCC/MT- genes, total-count normalize to 1e4, log1p, PCA(50)
spatial_policy: coordinate-only Euclidean adjacency, search_l target p=0.5, no image features
decoder: SpaGCN DEC, louvain initialization, fixed resolution=0.4, n_neighbors=10; no target cluster count
